note: TWO vocabularies, keyed separately. `areas` = the customer's own ERP area, verbatim from the workbook (CAPITAL-1 and CAPITAL-2 stay apart) — it reconciles with Supabase customer_master_stage.area, and each slot's salesmanAreas lists the salesmen covering it. `salesmanAreas` = the 9 SUPERVISOR AREAS (key sales -> the Supervisor Area the master carries, van sales -> the supervisor area owning the route, neither -> Others); each slot's rawAreas lists the ERP areas inside it. There is no channel prefix in a NAME: CAPITAL, SALALAH and Others each hold key AND van customers, and the channel is a separate axis instead — each slot carries `directIds` (type = 'Direct Sales', i.e. Key Sales) and `vanIds` (type = 'Van Sales') beside the pooled `customerIds`, so an area grant narrowed to one channel (app_user_areas.channel) scopes to that channel's customers alone. The two are disjoint and sit inside customerIds, but they can sum to one LESS than `matched`: a backend id whose master rows disagree about the channel is in neither, because an ambiguous channel must not leak into either grant. AREA GRANTS AND ACCESS CONTROL USE `salesmanAreas`. Customer Master BP names matched to ng2_bootstrap customer ids (uppercased, non-alphanumerics stripped). Unmatched customers have no sales rows in the backend under that spelling.
